{{Quote|Hello, friends. I am Gor Kolomo, proprietor of Uffel.|Gor Kolomo|<ref name="Uffel" />}}
'''Gor Kolomo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who traveled to [[Uffel]] to investigate it for mineral exploitation. However, he and his companion were killed when their ship crashed. He was survived by his droid [[QS-2D]] who eventually claimed its own independence.<ref name="Living Force Campaign Guide">''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]''</ref> QS-2D maintained the fiction that Kolomo was alive and the proprietor of the [[X2-4]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]]-manufacturing plant on [[Uffel]]. In this capacity, QS sent out holograms of Kolomo to maintain the fiction of his survival.<ref name="Uffel" /> In [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Kolomo announced to the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] that droid manufacture was halted by a debris storm. This caused a stir throughout the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], which had a high demand for Uffel droids.<ref name="No Droids">{{Wizards|url=rpga/livingforce/article.asp?x=lf/swlf20010927a_uffel&c=swlfc|text=No Droids for You!}}</ref> Shortly after this, he recruited some heroes from Cularin for some investigative work. It turned out that a rogue droid [[LN-73]] was trying to take over the manufacturing plant, and the heroes had to foil these plans.<ref name="Uffel" />

Kolomo's hologram was not prefect quality. In it he moved jerkily and had a facial tic under his left eye.<ref name="Uffel" />
